title: Establish interlock checkpoints and SLA for PRD sign-offs across Eng/Design/Legal
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Create a lightweight, enforceable interlock and SLA model for PRD reviews and sign-offs involving Engineering, Design, and Legal to avoid last-minute scope churn and release delays.

Scope:
- Define sign-off checkpoints for three PRD stages: Draft, Implementation-Ready (post-design/arch), and Release-Ready (final legal + security).
- Set target SLAs for reviewer turnaround and a standard escalation path.
- Produce a sign-off checklist template (confluence) and an acceptance matrix that can be attached to PRDs.
- Pilot the process on the upcoming runtime-1.18 rollout and one Private deployment PRD.

Acceptance criteria (must be met before marking Done):
1) A documented interlock flow with owners for each checkpoint published in Confluence and linked in the PRD.
2) SLA table agreed by Eng/Design/Legal with explicit turnaround times (e.g., Design 48h, Eng 72h, Legal 72–96h depending on complexity) and definitions of "complexity tiers".
3) A PRD sign-off checklist template (copyable) that includes security/kms/audit items and risk classification.
4) An escalation matrix with named contacts and SLA breach procedures.
5) Pilot run completed for two PRDs with retrospective notes and at least one iteration of checklist improvement.
6) Sidecar acceptance flag implemented in PRD metadata (manual for pilot) and instructions for Console release gating documented.

Out of scope for this ticket: tooling automation (integration with Linear flags or Console gating) — follow-up ticket will capture automation work after pilot results.

Stakeholders and reviewers:
- Product: Ava Chen (owner), Marcus Rivera (assignee), Priya Kapoor (PM reviewer)
- Engineering: Lina Gomez (runtime lead), Tom Park (infra), ENG-2011 reference
- Design: Maya Singh (design reviewer)
- Legal & Compliance: David O'Neill (counsel)
- Security: Rashid Alvi (security reviewer)

Deliverables:
- Confluence page: "PRD Interlock & SLA" (starter draft: https://confluence.redwood.example/prd-interlock)
- Sign-off checklist template (copyable doc)
- Trial log for two PRDs with timestamps and outcomes (attached to Confluence)
- Retro notes and recommended next steps (automation ticket scope)

Risks and mitigation:
- Legal turnaround may vary with regulatory scope — mitigation: classify PRDs by risk tier early so that legal can triage high-risk items.
- Review SLAs might be missed during peak cycles — mitigation: include a 24h expedited path for critical releases and a named on-call reviewer.

Next steps:
1) Kickoff alignment meeting 2026-03-02 with Eng/Design/Legal.
2) Publish first Confluence draft 2026-03-04.
3) Run pilot on runtime-1.18 PRD (PM-7012) and a Private deployment PRD (PM-5123).
4) Collect pilot data and iterate by 2026-03-15.
